items.name: bluebubbles

items.name: camsnap
items.label: 📸 camsnap
items.description: Capture frames or clips from RTSP/ONVIF cameras.

items.name: clawhub
items.label: clawhub
items.description: Use the ClawHub CLI to search, install, update, and publish agent skills from clawhub.com. Use when you need to fetch new skills on the fly, sync installed skills to latest or a specific version, or publish new/updated skill folders with the npm-installed clawhub CLI.

items.name: coding-agent
items.label: 🧩 coding-agent
items.description: Delegate coding tasks to Codex, Claude Code, or Pi agents via background process. Use when: (1) building/creating new features or apps, (2) reviewing PRs (spawn in temp dir), (3) refactoring large codebases, (4) iterative coding that needs file exploration. NOT for: simple one-liner fixes (just edit), reading code (use read tool), thread-bound ACP harness requests in chat (for example spawn/run Codex or Claude Code in a Discord thread; use sessions_spawn with runtime:"acp"), or any work in ~/clawd workspace (never spawn agents here). Claude Code: use --print --permission-mode bypassPermissions (no PTY). Codex/Pi/OpenCode: pty:true required.

items.name: discord
items.label: 🎮 discord
items.description: Discord ops via the message tool (channel=discord).

items.name: eightctl
items.label: 🛌 eightctl
items.description: Control Eight Sleep pods (status, temperature, alarms, schedules).

items.name: gemini
items.label: ✨ gemini
items.description: Gemini CLI for one-shot Q&A, summaries, and generation.

items.name: gh-issues
items.label: gh-issues
items.description: Fetch GitHub issues, spawn sub-agents to implement fixes and open PRs, then monitor and address PR review comments. Usage: /gh-issues [owner/repo] [--label bug] [--limit 5] [--milestone v1.0] [--assignee @me] [--fork user/repo] [--watch] [--interval 5] [--reviews-only] [--cron] [--dry-run] [--model glm-5] [--notify-channel -1002381931352]

items.name: gifgrep
items.label: 🧲 gifgrep
items.description: Search GIF providers with CLI/TUI, download results, and extract stills/sheets.

items.name: github
items.label: 🐙 github
items.description: GitHub operations via `gh` CLI: issues, PRs, CI runs, code review, API queries. Use when: (1) checking PR status or CI, (2) creating/commenting on issues, (3) listing/filtering PRs or issues, (4) viewing run logs. NOT for: complex web UI interactions requiring manual browser flows (use browser tooling when available), bulk operations across many repos (script with gh api), or when gh auth is not configured.

items.name: gog
items.label: 🎮 gog
items.description: Google Workspace CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs.

items.name: goplaces

items.description: Query Google Places API (New) via the goplaces CLI for text search, place details, resolve, and reviews. Use for human-friendly place lookup or JSON output for scripts.

items.name: healthcheck

items.name: himalaya

items.description: CLI to manage emails via IMAP/SMTP. Use `himalaya` to list, read, write, reply, forward, search, and organize emails from the terminal. Supports multiple accounts and message composition with MML (MIME Meta Language).

items.name: imsg

items.name: mcporter

items.label: describe-design

Use when the user asks to: (1) Document how a feature works, (2) Create an architecture overview, (3) Explain code structure for onboarding or knowledge transfer, (4) Research and describe a system's design. Produces markdown documents with Mermaid diagrams and stable code references suitable for humans and AI agents.

items.name: Product Manager

items.name: Self-Improving + Proactive Agent
items.label: Self-Improving + Proactive Agent
items.description: Self-reflection + Self-criticism + Self-learning + Self-organizing memory. Agent evaluates its own work, catches mistakes, and improves permanently. Use when (1) a command, tool, API, or operation fails; (2) the user corrects you or rejects your work; (3) you realize your knowledge is outdated or incorrect; (4) you discover a better approach; (5) the user explicitly installs or references the skill for the current task.

items.name: Software Architect

items.name: tactical-negotiation
items.label: tactical-negotiation
items.description: tactical negotiation playbook for client, sales, vendor, procurement, salary, internal stakeholder, creator, kol, koc, influencer, community, ambassador, affiliate, and partnership negotiations. use when preparing for a negotiation, handling price pushback, protecting margin, structuring cash versus upside, trading concessions, drafting a dm or email, coaching a live call, mapping leverage, reviewing risky terms, handling creator objections, or deciding whether to walk away. combines tactical empathy methods inspired by chris voss with practical deal design, batna, scope control, hard-mode diagnostics, contract-risk checks, and creator deal structures.

items.name: telegram-rich-messages
items.label: telegram-rich-messages
items.description: Comprehensive guide for Telegram Rich UI features (Inline buttons, formatting, media, reactions, and message management). Use this skill to provide a low-friction, interactive experience for Telegram users, prioritizing buttons over typing.

items.name: tg
items.label: tg
items.description: Telegram CLI for reading, searching, and sending messages. Use when the user asks about Telegram messages, wants to check inbox, search chats, send messages, or look up contacts and groups.

items.name: think-cog
items.label: 💭 think-cog
items.description: Complex ideas need iteration, not conversation. Think → Do → Review → Repeat. CellCog completes the full loop — brainstorming, reasoning, problem-solving, strategic thinking, then executing across every modality: research, documents, visuals, data, prototypes. Like having an Alfred who doesn't just advise — he builds.
